text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof plate: 3 mm sheet 750 x 650, the outside of the top frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 150 hole in the centre for the flue.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 14 holes 9 mm, 12.5 in from the edge, to match the frame:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: five along each side, two more at each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld twelve M8 studs on top for the economizer base, 15 in from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its edge (mark them from the economizer base plate).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roof board: 50 mm fibre board 594 x 494 with a 150 hole, pinned

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the plate with stainless pins and speed washers, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on a 12 mm ceramic rope gasket on the frame; 14 M8 bolts,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nuts under the frame. The board fits inside the wall lining.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the roof seats on the rope all round; no light shows.
